lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ንስምኪ ዝጸውዑ ብእምነት
ኣምሊጦም’ዮም ሓዊ እሳት
ኣደ ጐይታ ማርያም ቅድስት ንጽህት
[[/chorus]]

ብኪዳንኪ ብዙሓት ድኂኖም
ብምልጃኺ ጽድቂ ረኺቦም’ዮም
[[highlight]]ሕያውነት ኣምላኽ ጥዒሞም /2/[[/highlight]]

ባሕሪ ሓዊ በኣኺ ሰገሩ
ንዲያብሎስ ብዓወት ሰዓሩ
[[highlight]]ኣብ ላዕሊ ኣብ ሰማይ ከበሩ /2/[[/highlight]]

ነፍሶም’ውን ንጽድቂ ወኒና
ሕይወቶም’ውን ብኣኺ ድኂና
[[highlight]]ለምኒ እንኮላይ ንዓና /2/[[/highlight]]

ንሕና’ውን ብኣኺ ንእመን
ክትማልዲ ዘወትር ንልምን
[[highlight]]እነሆ ደቅኺ ንምሕጸን /2/[[/highlight]]

ምእመናን ጽድቂ ዝሕልኑ
ኣደ ኣምላኽ ዘክርና ይብሉ
[[highlight]]ናብ ፍቑር ወድኺ ይምህለሉ /2/[[/highlight]]
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
Nismiki zitsewʿu biʾimnet
ʾAmlit'om’yom hawi ʾisat
ʾAde goyta Maryam qidist nitshit
[[/chorus]]

Bikidanki bizuhat dihinom
Bimlijakhi tsidqi rekhibom’yom
[[highlight]]Hiyawnet ʾamlakh t'iʿimom /2/[[/highlight]]

Bahri hawi beʾakhi segeru
Nidiyablos biʿawet seʿaru
[[highlight]]ʾAb laʿili ʾab semay keberu /2/[[/highlight]]

Nefsom’win nitsdiqi wenina
Hiywetom’win biʾakhi dihina
[[highlight]]Lemni ʾinkolay niʿana /2/[[/highlight]]

Nihna’win biʾakhi niʾimen
Kitmaldi zewetr nilmin
[[highlight]]ʾIneho deqkhi nimhitsen /2/[[/highlight]]

Miʾimenan tsidqi zihlinu
ʾAde ʾamlakh zekrina yiblu
[[highlight]]Nab fiqhur wedkhi yimhilelu /2/[[/highlight]]
